name: NFL
author: themo
description: Follow an NFL team from the Omarchy bar. One glyph in the bar, and a popup with the full season: next game with a live score while it is on, upcoming fixtures, results, and the division or conference table. Pick your team from a searchable list inside the panel — no config file editing.

barWidget.description: Schedule, live score, results and standings for any of the 32 NFL teams. Data comes from ESPN's public API; python3 is the only dependency.

schema.label: Team
schema.description: ESPN team abbreviation, e.g. sf, kc, dal. Only a starting point — picking a team inside the panel overrides this and is what most people should use.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: What the widget shows in the bar itself. A live game always wins and shows the running score, whichever format is set.

options.label: Icon only
options.description: A single football glyph in the bar's narrow icon slot

schema.label: Refresh every (minutes)
schema.description: How often ESPN is polled. Drops to one minute on its own while a game is live.

schema.label: Upcoming games listed
schema.description: Set to 0 to hide the upcoming section.

schema.label: Results listed
schema.description: Newest first. Set to 0 to hide the results section.

schema.label: Standings on open
schema.description: Which table the panel starts on. Both are one click apart inside the panel.

schema.label: Bar glyph
schema.description: The Nerd Font glyph in the bar. Default is nf-fa-football (U+ED69).

schema.label: Win color
schema.description: Color of the W badge on results. Losses use the theme's own urgent color.
